en: The image depicts a grand, ornate palace set in formal gardens with wide paths and symmetrical landscaping. The building has a distinct European architectural style, with a tall, tower-like corner and mansard roofs. The postcard includes multilingual text in French, Bulgarian (Cyrillic), and a Latin transliteration, indicating the name and location of the palace: 'Le Palais Princier d’Euxinograd' in Varna.
